dispatch-test-bindings.title: Independent test tools for this run
dispatch-test-bindings.boundary: Overrides apply only to this execution. Published test nodes remain unchanged. Actual same-commit evidence, a different Worker and human acceptance still pass the original gates.
dispatch-test-bindings.catalog_scope: {{loaded}} test tools in the loaded directory window; {{total}} total tool configurations. A directory entry is not current dispatch approval.
dispatch-test-bindings.tool: Override tool for this test node
dispatch-test-bindings.phase.reading: Checking this selection against the task, workflow and execution route…
dispatch-test-bindings.phase.ready: Selection checked for the current route. The formal preview will verify it again.
dispatch-test-bindings.phase.changed: The returned selection details did not match. Recheck the exact selection or keep the published definition.
dispatch-test-bindings.phase.blocked: This selection cannot be used with the current dispatch setup.
dispatch-test-bindings.phase.unknown: The selection could not be confirmed. Recheck explicitly.
dispatch-test-bindings.phase.forbidden: Current access is unavailable; earlier selections cannot be used.
dispatch-test-bindings.no_tests: No original test node is linked to the selected Agent.
dispatch-test-bindings.limit: Up to 64 explicit test overrides can be fixed in one preview.
dispatch-test-bindings.denied: Current tool access is unavailable. Earlier protected selections are hidden. Read the current directory and select again.
dispatch-test-bindings.catalog_error: The tool directory could not be read. Restore the current directory before choosing an override.
dispatch-test-bindings.recommendation_ma: Test tool overrides use the formal preview below. New recommendation creation is disabled; an original pending operation can still be checked and recovered.
